items.title: Everest Group (EG) Completes Latin America Insurance Exit With Chile And Colombia Deals
items.summary: Everest Group (NYSE:EG) agreed to sell its Chile insurance operations to AIG, finalizing its retreat from Latin American commercial retail insurance. AIG also completed its purchase of Everest Group's Colombia insurance business, closing out Everest's remaining retail footprint in the region.
